title: Outstandingly Oven Roasted Irish Vegetable Hash
description: A charred and fluffy Irish dish featuring stir-fry vegetables and a sweet glaze, perfect for a show-stopping breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sweet potatoes, carrots, brussels sprouts, red onion, and bell pepper with the olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables out in a single layer on a large baking sheet.
Roast the vegetables in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the vegetables are roasting, whisk together the honey and apple cider vinegar in a small bowl.
After the vegetables have roasted for 30 minutes, brush the honey and apple cider vinegar glaze over them.
Continue to roast the vegetables for an additional 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly charred.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Serve the roasted vegetable hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
